title: Duolingo Plus / Construction
slide_intent: Specify relationships within a product lockup because small spacing changes can disrupt legibility and family consistency.
strategic_value: Reusing a shape from the Duolingo wordmark can give the Plus token a coherent relationship to the master signature.
demonstration: An annotated construction diagram uses the o counter as a reference for inter-element spacing, token padding, top alignment and baseline relationships.
practical_value: Use the illustrated counter-based construction when checking the supplied Plus lockup.

content_islands.name: Construction diagram
content_islands.spec: Keep the wordmark, Plus token and counter-derived measurement shapes in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Relationship rules
content_islands.spec: Place the heading, legibility rationale and reference-shape uses in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text states legibility and consistency as reasons to preserve the logo-element relationship.
reference_purposes.Application: The o counter provides a construction reference for gap, padding and alignment.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source instructs users to keep the placement and relationship of the elements intact.

ingredient.name: Plus lockup geometry
ingredient.role: Connect the product token to the master signature consistently.
ingredient.application: Preserve the supplied relationship; the gap equals the o-counter width, which also informs token padding, top alignment and character baselines in the diagram.
ingredient.scope: Historical archived guidelines. Historical Plus construction. Use the actual diagram for those relationships rather than assigning one universal numeric padding.
